checks.name: independent task-standing safety probe
checks.method: Random gate histories (1 to 7 rows) written into a scratch main checkout and its linked worktree at one code identity: npm test, suite:beta and suite:alpha rows, per-task pass or fail, worktree npm test rows that carry tasks from main's passing rows, and six row-integrity failures (abandoned roots, stopped, timed out, changed identity, changed build output, memory failure). An oracle written in the probe, not the subject's decidingExecution, takes each task's standing from its latest executed result among the worktree's executions at the identity under any check, or main's when the worktree has none, and calls it safe only when that result passed in an intact row. A violation is a row the claim check accepts, or a task the runner carries, whose standing is unsafe, or a carried result whose source row did not execute a pass of that task. Agreement counts claims accepted while the runner would not carry every task.
